meta.name: influencer-prospecting
meta.description: Use when the user wants to find creators, influencers, affiliates, or social accounts in a niche for outreach, partnerships, sponsorships, UGC, seeding, or competitive research. Produces scored prospect lists from public social data.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按领域筛选出值得合作的影响者名单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想找特定领域的影响者做推广或合作
copy.tagline_en: Find influencers worth partnering with in any niche
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to find influencers in a niche for partnerships or promotion

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 能根据用户指定的领域,从公开社交数据中找出网红/创作者,评估契合度、受众、互动等,输出带评分的候选名单,可导出 CSV。
howto.when: 当用户请求寻找某领域的网红/创作者、制作UGC/联盟/赞助等名单,或导出候选人CSV时触发。

say.text: 帮我找美妆领域适合做UGC的中腰部博主
say.note: Claude 会列出候选并打分

say.text: 找在TikTok上谈论宠物食品的创作者,目标美国市场
say.note: 按受众与品类契合度筛选

say.text: 把上一批候选人导出成CSV

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can find creators/influencers in a niche using public social data, score them on fit, reach, engagement, etc., and output a scored prospect list with CSV export.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to find influencers or creators in a niche, build UGC/affiliate/sponsorship lists, find micro-influencers, or export prospect CSVs.

say_en.text: Find mid-tier beauty creators for UGC campaigns.
say_en.note: Claude will list and score prospects.

say_en.text: Find TikTok creators talking about pet food, target US audience.
say_en.note: Filters by audience and niche fit.

say_en.text: Export the last prospect list as CSV.
